title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
Hidden quietly among the oak trees… I watch the scene unfold.

Abraham speaks with the travelers outside the tent…
And inside, Sarah hears the words that seem impossible.

For a moment she freezes…
Then a quiet laugh escapes before she can stop it.

Not a laugh of mockery…
But the sound of hope colliding with reality.

Years of waiting.
Years of silence.
Years of wondering if the promise had passed her by.
And then the question fills the still afternoon air:
“Is anything too hard for the Lord?”
Standing there as a witness… I realize something about faith.
Sometimes hope arrives when our hearts have already decided it cannot.
And yet God speaks promises that stretch far beyond what we think is possible.
So I find myself asking quietly…
What promise in my life feels too big to believe right now?
